2f5ed27c03cba425.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مداره للاستشارات الهندسية عن سكرتير تنفيذي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. يهدف الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الإداري والتنظيمي للمدير/الرئيس، مما يضمن سير العمليات اليومية بسلاسة وفعالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنظيم وإدارة مواعيد المدير/الرئيس وتذكيره بها بشكل مستمر. التعامل مع الاستفسارات الواردة والرد عليها، بالإضافة إلى استلام وتوزيع البريد والمراسلات الموجهة للمدير/الرئيس. إعداد المذكرات الدورية والمراسلات المتعلقة بعمل الوحدات التنظيمية الداخلية. إجراء المراسلات الاعتيادية مع الجهات الخارجية، والتأكد من توقيعها من المدير/الرئيس، ثم توزيعها. حضور الاجتماعات، وتسجيل محاضرها بدقة، ثم تحريرها وتوثيقها. حفظ وتنظيم جميع الوثائق والملفات المتعلقة بأعمال المدير/الرئيس بطريقة منهجية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها، وحفظها لسهولة الرجوع إليها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال السكرتارية التنفيذية أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على تنظيم المهام المتعددة وإدارة الوقت بفعالية. مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية ممتازة. المهارات المطلوبة إتقان استخدام برامج مايكروسوفت أوفيس (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). القدرة على التعامل مع المعلومات السرية بحرفية. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية قوية. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل. بيئة العمل يعمل السكرتير التنفيذي ضمن فريق مداره للاستشارات الهندسية في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في المكتب لتقديم الدعم المباشر للمدير/الرئيس. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في مداره للاستشارات الهندسية.

2fb124338ca3bd2b.description: About the Role LUMA Energy is seeking a Business Partner Organizational Development for a full-time position in Tabuk, with work locations including Neom. This role involves acting as a strategic consultant to business leaders, focusing on diagnosing organizational needs and implementing solutions to enhance leadership and team capabilities across the organization. Key Responsibilities Diagnose organizational, team, role, and process gaps in structure, capability, and culture, designing solutions for workflow, roles, spans/layers, and strategic workforce planning to improve alignment and efficiency. Lead change readiness assessments, stakeholder analysis, and communication planning, guiding leaders and teams through transitions via coaching, facilitation, and resistance management. Deliver leadership development programs, workshops, and coaching aligned to enterprise leadership models, including 360/succession-planning facilitation and targeted development. Partner with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) to strengthen the talent lifecycle, including performance management, succession, career pathing, and engagement, and analyze talent/culture/engagement data. Leverage organizational, talent, and performance data to inform diagnosis, developing dashboards and insight reports to guide executive decision-making and measure OD impact. Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders, bringing data, insights, and OD consulting methodology to strategic conversations, and partnering with various departments to drive integrated solutions. Interpret, apply, and reinforce company policies, procedures, and standards, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, industry regulations, and internal governance requirements. Participate in storm restoration tasks and assigned drills to contribute to the safe and reliable recovery of services. Perform additional responsibilities aligned with senior-level expertise and organizational needs, contributing to strategic projects and team development. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in organizational development, organizational psychology, human resources, or a business-related discipline. A Master’s Degree is preferred. Experience: 6 years of progressive human resources experience with functional responsibilities as described, including data collection, analysis, and interpretation. This must include at least 3 years of dedicated experience in organizational development, organizational design, change management, or leadership development. Experience leading complex, cross-functional projects or programs with organizational impact. Experience developing strategic solutions, frameworks, or governance models that align with business goals. Demonstrated expertise as the primary subject-matter advisor, providing high-impact consultation to senior leaders, internal partners, and external stakeholders. A Master’s degree in a relevant field may substitute for some experience when accompanied by a minimum of 3 years of progressive experience in functional area responsibilities, with dedicated experience in organizational development, organizational design, change management, or leadership development in large and complex organizations. Physical Demands and Working Conditions The role primarily involves a stationary position. Seldom requirements include pushing/pulling/reaching, kneeling, grabbing, bending, and lifting/carrying up to 15 pounds. Vision and hearing abilities are required. Working conditions seldom involve wet or humid environments or loud noise. The role does not involve working near moving mechanical parts, heavy machinery, in high places, with fumes or airborne particles, or with electricity.

2fb1b959574a68df.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع رفال المميز الطبي في الرياض عن مدير إداري للانضمام إلى فريقه. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب قيادة العمليات الإدارية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية، ويفضل أن يكون لدى المرشح خبرة سابقة في المجال الطبي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في صياغة الأهداف الأساسية للشؤون الإدارية، وتطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج والمشاريع التي تساهم في تحقيق هذه الأهداف. ضمان وجود أطر ومقاييس دقيقة لتقييم مستوى تحقيق الخطط والأهداف الإدارية. الإشراف على عمليات تطوير ومراجعة جداول الصلاحيات الإدارية والإجراءات المتبعة في المجمع بهدف تحسينها. ضمان تقديم الخدمات الإدارية بالجودة والسرعة المطلوبة لجميع الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين. متابعة وتوجيه أنشطة تلبية احتياجات الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين من الخدمات الإدارية المتنوعة، مثل النقل والضيافة والنظافة. تنظيم المراسلات والأرشفة والتشغيل الإداري للمباني والمرافق. الإشراف على تطبيق الأنظمة والتعليمات والقرارات الإدارية الصادرة عن الإدارة العليا. ضمان إبلاغ الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين بكافة القرارات والتعليمات الإدارية ومتابعة تنفيذها. الإشراف على إعداد الملخصات والتقارير التي توضح نسب الإنجاز العامة في الشؤون الإدارية وتقديمها للإدارة العليا. إحاطة الإدارة العليا بالتحديات والمستجدات، وتقديم المشورة بشأن القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية المهمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة سابقة في مجال الإدارة، ويفضل أن تكون في المجال الطبي. القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج الإدارية. مهارات ممتازة في الإشراف والمتابعة والتوجيه. بيئة العمل يعمل المدير الإداري ضمن مجمع رفال المميز الطبي في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة عمل متكاملة تهدف إلى تقديم خدمات طبية عالية الجودة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى مجمع رفال المميز الطبي، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم لهذا الدور الإداري الهام.

2ff5ec034b69cf17.description: About My Clinic KSA My Clinic KSA is a leading multispecialty outpatient care provider in Saudi Arabia, committed to helping individuals live longer, healthier, and happier lives. Established in 2017, the organization focuses on innovation, care, collaboration, ambition, and responsibility in healthcare delivery. Role Overview: Home Care Nurse / Lab Phlebotomist My Clinic KSA is seeking a dedicated Home Care Nurse / Lab Phlebotomist to join its team in Jeddah and Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves the collection of various specimen samples and the accurate labeling of blood vials within a home care setting. The scope of responsibility includes transporting all collected blood and specimen samples to the laboratory. Key Responsibilities Identify patients of all ages by verifying their full name against requisition details. Perform blood withdrawals consistently and accurately, adhering to established laboratory procedures, including proper patient identification and tube selection. Verify and collect appropriate samples for specific tests. Accurately label specimens with patient name, MRN, initials, date/time collected, and collecting staff initials, and record details on all laboratory requisition forms and phlebotomy logs. Instruct patients of all ages on correct urine specimen collection methods (*, for C&S, GTTs). Process all laboratory requisitions, forms, and specimens for routine and reference tests correctly. Complete duties neatly, accurately, timely, and professionally. Enforce and follow all laboratory safety rules, reporting potential hazards to the HHC Head Nurse and adhering to clinical policy regarding standard precautions. Communicate effectively with team members regarding difficult venipuncture cases or timed specimens. Maintain adequate supplies of specimen collection equipment for routine, special, and reference tests, and process incoming supplies correctly. Organize work for effective time utilization and report to work as scheduled. Refer to appropriate policy and procedure manuals as needed and communicate with reference labs for specimen requirements. Accept responsibility for and be available to work different shifts when workload or conditions require. Greet patients courteously, responding with empathy and positive interpersonal skills, and foster cooperative working relationships with colleagues. Demonstrate the ability to handle unexpected situations and exercise independent thought and action when necessary. Perform all required phlebotomy procedures competently in accordance with institutional policies, with particular emphasis on blood samples, blood cultures, referral tests, and specimen requirements. Assist in the orientation of new staff members as requested. Perform other assigned duties and submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports as required. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of relevant experience. Demonstrated competence in phlebotomy procedures. Ability to follow established laboratory procedures and safety rules. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Jeddah and Makkah, Saudi Arabia, involving home care settings. The role requires adherence to clinical policies and a commitment to patient safety and accurate specimen handling.

2f9670c7cf193af0.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة طبعة اليقين عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى مساعد إداري في مدينة جدة. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. يهدف الدور إلى دعم العمليات الإدارية والتشغيلية اليومية للشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ ومتابعة الأعمال الإدارية والتشغيلية اليومية المتنوعة. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء للرد على استفساراتهم ومتابعة طلباتهم. تنسيق المواعيد والاجتماعات وتنظيم جداول العمل بكفاءة. إعداد التقارير والمراسلات وتنظيم الملفات والمستندات بشكل منهجي. إدخال البيانات وتحديثها بانتظام ومتابعة سير العمل. التنسيق بين الأقسام المختلفة لضمان إنجاز المهام بسلاسة. تنفيذ المهام الأخرى التي تُكلّف بها الإدارة ضمن نطاق العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تنفيذ المهام الإدارية والتشغيلية بفعالية. هذه الوظيفة متاحة لذوي الاحتياجات الخاصة، مع توفير التسهيلات المناسبة لطبيعة العمل. المزايا الوظيفية بيئة عمل احترافية ومحفزة. فرص للتدريب والتطوير المهني المستمر. إمكانية اكتساب خبرات متنوعة في الأعمال الإدارية والتشغيلية. فرص للنمو والتطور الوظيفي داخل الشركة. تفاصيل إضافية الراتب المتوقع لهذا الدور يتراوح بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي. تلتزم شركة طبعة اليقين بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة لجميع الموظفين.

2fa78dd51c7422a5.description: About the Role Tuwaiq Casting & Forging Company is seeking an Operational Technology Engineer to join its IT Department in Ras Tannurah, Eastern Region. This full-time role reports to the OT Manager and is responsible for the design, implementation, operation, and security of the plant's Operational Technology (OT) environment. The primary objective is to ensure reliable, safe, and efficient manufacturing operations, alongside seamless IT/OT integration across the company. Key Responsibilities Administer, maintain, and support OT systems, including L1/L2 connections, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Kepware, and AVEVA Historian platforms. Integrate plant-floor data with enterprise systems such as ERP, MES, and dashboards using protocols like OPC UA/DA, Modbus, and Profinet. Provide L2/L3 technical support for OT incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Implement and monitor OT cybersecurity controls, including access management, patching, backups, antivirus solutions, and secure remote connections. Develop and maintain OT system backups, disaster recovery plans, and business continuity procedures. Manage OT assets, configuration records, network diagrams, and system documentation. Support OT projects, upgrades, and Capital Expenditure (CapEx) initiatives from requirements definition through commissioning and handover. Coordinate with production, maintenance, quality teams, vendors, and system integrators on OT requirements and service delivery. Ensure compliance with Tuwaiq Casting & Forging's IT/OT policies, Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) requirements, and applicable national regulations (*, NCA OTCC). Prepare technical reports, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and recommendations for continuous improvement of OT performance and reliability. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field, demonstrating a strong understanding of Operational Technology environments and industrial control systems. Technical Environment The role involves working with control systems, industrial networks, MES, and data historian platforms. Familiarity with protocols such as OPC UA/DA, Modbus, and Profinet is essential for integrating plant-floor data with enterprise systems. Work Setting This is a full-time position based in Ras Tannurah, Eastern Region, within the IT Department of Tuwaiq Casting & Forging Company. The role requires collaboration with various internal departments and external vendors to ensure operational efficiency and compliance.

2fa1671493fd4ba6.description: About the Role Ultimate Peaks Talent & Strategy is seeking a Sales Accounts Executive to join their team in the Makkah region, covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role focuses on managing and exceeding sales targets within an assigned territory, promoting the company's vision, culture, and values, and ensuring high customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Achieve and exceed sales targets within the assigned area/territory. Close deals with new and existing customers through presentations, contract negotiations, and service promotion. Analyze revenue and shipment results, implementing corrective actions to drive quality revenue. Expand the customer base by acquiring new business and increasing active customers. Prepare and submit required reports (weekly, monthly, one-off) in a timely manner. Manage customer issues and inquiries, coordinating with other departments to ensure timely responses. Monitor market and competitor activities, reporting changes and executing agreed actions. Promote existing and new services, supporting management in launching services and executing marketing campaigns. Support credit control in achieving collection targets and resolving customer payment issues. Assist with customers' special project requirements, coordinating with stakeholders and monitoring implementation. Promote and implement automated tools for customers. Maintain required documentation for all active, non-active, and prospective clients. Create and develop sales presentations. Coordinate pricing with the Finance department, ensuring guidelines are applied and profitability targets are met. Review customer prices regularly and renegotiate when discrepancies arise between actual and promised volumes. Maintain customer data, including contracts, correspondence, business activities, shipping profiles, and special requirements. Identify market weaknesses, opportunities, strengths, and threats. Establish strong business relationships and ensure customer satisfaction. Develop and implement a personal sales plan and call cycle. Ensure adherence to company policies and procedures and efficient sales processes. Contribute to department performance by achieving individual KPI objectives. Monitor and reduce lost revenue. Business Continuity Engagement Actively participate in business continuity training and awareness programs. Understand and adhere to business continuity plans and emergency response procedures. Report observed risks or potential threats to operational continuity. Adhere to data protection policies to ensure information integrity and confidentiality. Recognize and respond appropriately to incidents or crises, escalating to management as needed. Qualifications and Experience Minimum 2 year of relevant experience. Performance Metrics Performance will be measured against individual Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) as set for the current financial year. Work Type This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, covering Jeddah and Makkah.

2fef49d9e8d63c77.description: About the Role Almarai is seeking a Senior Team Manager – Engineering to oversee engineering maintenance and utilities operations at its Seafood Processing Plant. This full-time position is based in the Makkah region, specifically covering King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah, and Rabigh. The role focuses on ensuring the reliability, efficiency, and continuous operation of industrial HVAC, refrigeration, plant utilities, and processing equipment, while upholding high standards of safety, quality, and operational performance. Key Responsibilities Lead and supervise a multi-skilled engineering and maintenance team. Oversee the operation and maintenance of industrial HVAC, refrigeration, and cooling systems. Ensure optimal performance of chillers, air handling units, compressors, and associated utilities. Plan and execute preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities. Troubleshoot equipment failures, conduct root cause analysis, and minimize downtime. Monitor equipment performance, maintenance KPIs, and operational efficiency. Ensure compliance with HSE standards, quality requirements, and maintenance procedures. Manage maintenance budgets, spare parts, and contractor activities. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance equipment reliability and reduce maintenance costs. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in engineering and maintenance. Demonstrated experience in leading engineering and maintenance teams. Proficiency in managing industrial HVAC, refrigeration, and plant utility systems. About Almarai Almarai is the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy and the region’s largest food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company. Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Almarai Company is recognized as the #1 FMCG Brand in the MENA region and holds a market leadership position across all its categories in the GCC. Almarai employs over 46,000 professionals across the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. In 2025, the company reported a net income of SAR billion on sales of SAR 22 billion. Almarai is engaged in an expansion program and strategic acquisitions in new vertical markets.

2ffea6d326d9e1f7.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking an Attendant Laundry to join their team in Medina, Al Madinah. This is a full-time position suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on the efficient and professional handling of laundry operations within the hotel. Key Responsibilities Operate and monitor washing, dry cleaning, and drying machinery, including adding necessary chemicals and cleaning lint traps. Identify stained or damaged items and determine appropriate action for repair, spot treatment, rewash, or discard. Inspect the cleanliness of articles removed from machines and place them into clean linen carts. Set dryers to designated times and temperatures based on fabric types. Remove lint and debris from dryer screens, dry cleaning filters, and drain traps after each load. Fold cleaned articles to designated sizes, either by hand or using a folding machine. Maintain accurate records of all laundered items. Operational Compliance and Team Support Adhere to all company safety and security policies and procedures, reporting accidents, injuries, and unsafe conditions to management. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Follow all company policies and procedures, ensuring a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues, supporting the team to achieve common goals. Listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Quality Assurance and Efficiency Ensure adherence to established quality expectations and standards. Identify, recommend, develop, and implement new methods to enhance organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines to identify any defects. Physical Requirements Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Capability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Navigate through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces, as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Additional Duties Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors to support the overall operation of the laundry department.

2f1974896a665280.description: About Baker Hughes Baker Hughes is seeking a Finance Advisor to join its Finance Team. The team provides financial support and insight for the business through planning, analysis, and reporting. It utilizes extensive data to aid in important decision-making that impacts the global organization and to identify areas for improvement, innovating through digitization to enhance value. Role Overview As a Finance Advisor, you will be responsible for providing regional Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) and reporting for Corporate, a specific business, or a P&L within a business. This full-time position requires a thorough understanding, application, and mastery of financial approaches, theories, methodologies, and their application within a concrete organizational context. The role involves 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Act as a business finance partner, assisting Operations in defining relevant growth plans. Define Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure performance across all organizational areas, including manufacturing, R&D, engineering, supply chain, and commissioning. Analyze performance and propose action plans to improve profitability and cash generation, as well as corrective action plans when necessary. Manage the business cycle, including the 3-year plan, budget, and forecasts at each organizational level. Provide advice and guidance to functional management or business functions on approaches, projects, programs, and ways of working within the functional area. Contribute to important business decisions or support business functions in decision-making, understanding broader cross-functional implications. Communicate high-level concepts effectively to Senior Leadership and executives. Deliver specialized professional work within single-layered teams or professional work within multi-layered teams. Handle complex professional work within the department, addressing unique cases that may lack precedent, emphasizing knowledge management and the development of new approaches. Lead, design, and implement projects. Required Skills and Experience Excellent written and oral communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. 5-10 years of relevant experience in finance or a related field. Work Environment This is a full-time position within a dynamic finance team that supports a global organization. The role involves working with extensive data to drive strategic decision-making and continuous improvement through digitization.

2f6a8aa9770c6188.description: About the Role Bupa Arabia is seeking a Senior Executive Manager for PR Contract Management to join their team in Makkah, with responsibilities covering Jeddah and Makkah. This contract-based role focuses on effective contract management and network design for healthcare providers, ensuring compliance with CCHI & SAMA regulations. The manager will drive price and cost management, achieve project savings, and align with sales and marketing to develop new products and services that support business development and profitability. Key Responsibilities Establish contract rules and standards with providers to serve business interests. Oversee and participate in contracting new providers, new service codes, and contract renewals, ensuring compliance with regulatory and licensing requirements. Implement systems for comprehensive benchmarking of frequently billed items and develop pricing models for unique services. Revamp the coding system, introduce unified parent codes, and implement ICD 10-AM systems, resolving issues of invalid/duplicate service codes and overbilling. Develop and negotiate price reduction plans, service bundling, and surgical package expansions to achieve cost-effectiveness. Manage and enhance the provider network to ensure comprehensive coverage, optimize accessibility and affordability, and manage pharmacy benefits. Enhance referral systems, develop anchor provider networks, and manage volume re-allocation of services. Explore and develop new payment approaches, strategic provider partnerships, and healthcare plans that respond to market needs. Ensure effective communication of contract changes, price forecasts, and network updates to relevant internal stakeholders. Team Leadership and Coordination Provide leadership, professional guidance, and direction to assigned team members. Prepare and oversee Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for the team. Coordinate with sales, marketing, and commercial finance on volume re-allocation, healthcare plans, and network updates. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in contract management, network design, or a similar field within the healthcare or insurance industry. Demonstrated ability to manage complex contracts and negotiate with providers. Strong understanding of regulatory requirements, including CCHI & SAMA rules and regulations. Experience in developing and implementing pricing models and cost-effectiveness strategies. Work Type This is a contract position. Location The role is based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah.

2f74dcd4ed5896d9.description: About Jasara Program Management Company JASARA PMC is a joint venture formed by PIF, Jacobs, and Aramco, operating within the management consulting sector. The company specializes in bringing together extensive project and professional services expertise to support complex, high-impact work. A strong emphasis is placed on operational rigor, financial discipline, and effective collaboration among stakeholders. The Role of Accounts Payable Senior Officer As an Accounts Payable Senior Officer, you will contribute significantly to maintaining the accuracy and integrity of the payables function at JASARA PMC. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is suited for a professional who is detail-oriented, highly organized, and capable of collaborating effectively across various teams. The role is crucial for ensuring smooth financial operations, strong internal controls, and the timely resolution of all payment-related matters. Key Responsibilities Process and verify supplier invoices by matching them against purchase orders and supporting documentation. Reconcile vendor accounts and promptly address any discrepancies related to invoices or payments. Prepare payment runs, ensuring all approvals adhere to established financial controls. Maintain accurate accounts payable records and support month-end closing activities. Coordinate with both vendors and internal teams to resolve outstanding payment inquiries. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in an Accounts Payable role or a similar financial position. Demonstrated strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Proven ability to work effectively across different teams and departments. Proficiency in financial operations and understanding of internal controls. Work Environment and Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role operates within a collaborative environment focused on maintaining financial discipline and effective stakeholder engagement. Application Information The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

2f811988363bdc65.description: About the Role Rosewood AMAALA is seeking a Saudi National for the role of Guest Services Associate Butler. This full-time position is responsible for all aspects of internal guest care during their stay, assisting across all hotel areas, and continuously improving skills through training and practice. The role is instrumental in delivering the highest professional standards in Butler Service, aiming to exceed guest expectations. The Butler is also a designated member of the Evacuation Team. Key Responsibilities Present a well-groomed, clean, and pleasant appearance, reporting to duty on time. Arrange and organize welcoming experience amenities for guests. Review and note information from the Butler Manager, operational boards, and the *** logbook. Check guest arrival details, including preferences, profile notes, and communications. Conduct in-depth handovers from the Floor Butler and maintain the pantry as clean, tidy, and well-stocked. Inspect arrival rooms, personalize them based on guest preferences, and ensure all equipment is functioning. Communicate with relevant departments to ensure rooms are ready according to Rosewood standards. Lead occupied room servicing, perform proper checks, and update guest preferences in the PMS. Escort guests to rooms, provide hotel and room orientation, and explain butler services. Maintain the Butler Portfolio (iPad, documents, earphones) and ensure all communication apps are functional. Offer luggage unpacking services and manage guest laundry, pressing, and dry-cleaning. Coordinate with the Florist for floral arrangements and manage fruit basket refills. Polish guest shoes, coordinate speed check-outs with the Front Desk, and deliver mail/messages promptly. Inform Housekeeping of service needs and maintain mini-fridge supplies, informing Room Service of charges. Add "WOW" factors to suites, including romantic set-ups, kids' paths, and personalized amenities. Book guest wake-up calls and assist with or introduce In-Room Dining (IRD) orders. Record all guest requirements in the iPad logbook and introduce team associates to guests. Process guest departures, including offering packing assistance, coordinating with reception and concierge, checking for left items, and reporting feedback. Communicate with the butler coordinator to send feedback emails to departing guests. Be fully aware of Fire and Evacuation procedures and carry out assigned duties with flexibility in hours. Guest Service and Operational Standards Provide elegant, discreet, and anticipatory service, ensuring guest comfort and satisfaction. Maintain strong knowledge of hotel services, facilities, and local attractions. Address guests by name, maintain professional relations, and respect cultural sensitivities and privacy. Complete proper shift handovers and monitor the cleanliness and maintenance of assigned areas. Prepare and coordinate work orders for Engineering as necessary. Comply with all Health & Safety regulations, wear protective equipment, and report defects or accidents. Attend mandatory Fire, Health & Safety training and be familiar with COSHH regulations and risk assessments. Maintain guest privacy and confidentiality, following all operating procedures precisely. Uphold Rosewood culture, grooming, and hygiene standards, representing the hotel with professionalism. Qualifications and Requirements Experience: Minimum 1-2 years in a Butler, Guest Services, or similar luxury-hospitality role. Skills: Proficient in computer systems and smart devices. Strong customer service and guest-interaction skills. Excellent verbal and written communication in English. Attributes: Keen attention to detail, strong organizational skills, time-management, and multitasking abilities. Team-oriented, cooperative, proactive, and able to work under pressure. Decision-Making: Ability to make sound decisions in the absence of the Butler Service Manager. Physical Requirements: Ability to perform physical activities including lifting, bending, walking, reaching, and standing for extended periods. Ability to communicate clearly. Certifications: Butler certification is preferred but not mandatory. Confidentiality During employment, access to confidential information regarding guests, associates, and company operations is expected. All such information must remain strictly confidential and must not be disclosed unless officially authorized.

2f85f0e667607374.description: About the Role Tamer Mölnlycke Care is seeking a Security & Safety Officer to join their team in Makkah, with operations covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time operational role is responsible for executing day-to-day security controls and assigned safety activities to protect people, property, materials, and operations. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Maintain continuous security observation, conduct scheduled patrols, and monitor CCTV screens and alarm systems, reporting any suspicious activity or abnormal conditions. Control and record the entry and exit of employees, visitors, contractors, and vehicles, performing authorized inspections and preventing unauthorized material entry. Verify, record, and report truck and delivery vehicle movements, monitoring incoming and outgoing materials and ensuring proper documentation. Conduct daily checks of fire-pump pressure, LEL gas-monitoring panels, fire extinguishers, emergency exits, and first-aid boxes, escalating any deficiencies. Issue work permits as authorized, follow up on permitted work, and monitor contractor compliance with site rules and PPE requirements. Support emergency drills, evacuation exercises, and alarm responses, including monitoring security, fire, and emergency notification systems. Observe chemical storage, waste segregation, and general housekeeping conditions during patrols, reporting any concerns or deficiencies. Monitor and coordinate the entry and movement of water/sewage tankers, meal delivery vehicles, and other service providers, maintaining required records. Prepare accurate daily security reports, maintain various security registers, and ensure clear shift handovers. Participate in site observation and incident prevention programs, deliver toolbox talks, and support briefings for visitors and contractors. Required Experience 2-5 years of experience in a security and safety role. Demonstrated ability to perform access control, security patrols, and monitoring activities. Experience with emergency readiness procedures and incident escalation. Proficiency in maintaining accurate records and preparing reports. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, supporting operations across Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves continuous facility protection and requires adherence to approved procedures for all security and safety activities.

These are delivered through its Location Independent Agile™ delivery model, recognized for excellence in software development. As part of the Tata group, India's largest multinational business group, TCS employs over 616,171 consultants across 53 countries. The specialist will be responsible for maintaining operational efficiency and supporting human capital functions. Key Responsibilities Manage contractor employment contracts, including creation, renewal, extension, and termination via SAP. 2fda065a64db3962.description: About the Role Pace | Architecture, Engineering + Planning is seeking an experienced Project Director to lead and manage large-scale projects within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA). This full-time position is based in Makkah, with projects spanning Jeddah and Makkah. The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering landmark mixed-use developments that contribute to the urban transformation of Saudi Arabia. Key Responsibilities Direct, manage, and lead large-scale mixed-use development projects, ensuring alignment with client objectives and project goals. Develop and execute project plans, schedules, budgets, and scope management strategies for successful delivery. Act as the primary point of contact for key stakeholders, including clients, senior leadership, contractors, and government agencies. Lead the coordination and integration of multidisciplinary teams across architecture, structural, mechanical, electrical, ELV, infrastructure, and civil engineering disciplines. Oversee all stages of the project lifecycle, from planning, design, and procurement to construction and handover. Manage project budgets, forecast expenditures, and implement cost control mechanisms to ensure financial success. Monitor project performance, ensuring adherence to cost, time, and quality benchmarks. Mitigate risks by identifying potential issues early and developing effective strategies to avoid delays or budget overruns. Ensure strict adherence to health, safety, and environmental standards throughout all project stages. Maintain transparent communication with clients and stakeholders regarding project progress, challenges, and changes. Prepare and present comprehensive project reports for senior leadership and stakeholders. Oversee contract negotiations and ensure compliance with contractual obligations. Lead, mentor, and motivate project teams, fostering a positive working environment and promoting professional growth. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 25 years of construction project experience within the AEC industry. Proven track record in Project Director roles with significant experience in large-scale mixed-use developments (residential, institutional, commercial, retail, hospitality). Extensive experience working with large multidisciplinary teams. In-depth knowledge of civil engineering principles, infrastructure, and construction methodologies. Expertise in project planning, budgeting, scheduling, and procurement management. Proven ability to lead complex projects from concept to completion while maintaining focus on deadlines and budgets. Experience in West Europe or North America, and the Arab Gulf / KSA regions is required. Strong understanding of KSA regulations, construction codes, and local market dynamics. Skills and Competencies Strong project leadership and strategic planning capabilities. Ability to manage teams from diverse engineering expertise and trades. Proficiency in project control measures for mega projects, including QA/QC, HSSE standards, and risk management. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Proficiency in using project management software for real-time project status updates. The Project Director will be part of a professional team dedicated to delivering significant urban development projects.

2fb6e1e642519c2a.description: About WSP in the Middle East WSP in the Middle East offers opportunities to contribute to significant projects and collaborate with professionals in the field. 2fe51d91f01b2278.description: About the Role ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail is seeking a Sr. Specialist IT Security to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern region. This full-time role focuses on implementing, administering, and maintaining the organization's enterprise security technologies. The primary objective is to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information systems and data. Role Context and Objectives The Sr. Specialist IT Security provides advanced technical expertise across security operations, including threat monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, access governance, and compliance. The role involves enforcing corporate security standards aligned with international frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001 and NIST, as well as Saudi national regulations like NCA ECC and OTCC. Collaboration with Infrastructure, Network, Cloud, Application, Service Desk, Cybersecurity, and Audit teams is essential to enhance the organization's cyber resilience. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain IT security reference architectures in alignment with ISO/IEC 27001, NIST SP 800-53, COBIT 2019, and applicable Saudi regulations (NCA ECC and OTCC). Implement, administer, and maintain enterprise security technologies including endpoint protection (EDR), next-generation firewalls, IDS/IPS, anti-malware, email and web security gateways, DLP, vulnerability scanners, and SIEM solutions. Continuously monitor security alerts, logs, and events; perform triage, investigation, escalation, and remediation of threats and incidents. Lead and support security incident response and forensic investigations, including containment, eradication, recovery, and root-cause analysis. Conduct risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and configuration reviews across systems, endpoints, networks, and cloud workloads; track findings through to closure. Collaborate with IT Infrastructure, Network, Applications, Cloud, and Service Desk teams to embed security-by-design principles into projects, systems, and change management processes. Apply security baselines, configuration hardening, and patch-management policies across servers, endpoints, and cloud environments (*, CIS Benchmarks). Administer identity and access governance, including access provisioning, privileged access management (PAM), and periodic user access reviews. Ensure secure deployment and configuration of firewalls, network security layers, proxies, and security appliances. Develop, enforce, and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures aligned with enterprise governance. Support internal and external audits (*, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NCA compliance) through evidence collection, access reviews, and remediation tracking with Audit and Compliance teams. Maintain and periodically test disaster recovery and business continuity plans for security systems. Advise IT leadership on risk-mitigation strategies, emerging threats, and control improvements. Maintain accurate documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles, and drive continuous improvement of security operations. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in IT security is required for this role. Demonstrated expertise in implementing and maintaining enterprise security technologies. Familiarity with international security frameworks (ISO/IEC 27001, NIST) and Saudi national regulations (NCA ECC and OTCC). Work Type This is a full-time position within ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail.

Test, troubleshoot, repair, maintain, and install a variety of electronic, electromechanical, mechanical, computer, and laboratory equipment. Participate in on-the-job training (OJT) programs. Provide assistance and technical support as required. Perform soldering and cable connections for electronic parts and components. Experience in troubleshooting, fault isolation, repair, testing, and checkout procedures. Proficiency in soldering, splicing, and wire wrapping. General knowledge of maintenance workshop procedures. 2f4b02f16c4ce818.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة هيفاء بديع القلم وشركاها العالميه للتجارة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة دورة المبيعات الكاملة، بدءًا من بناء علاقات العملاء وحتى إتمام عمليات البيع وتحصيل الديون. يتطلب الدور مهارات قوية في التواصل والمتابعة لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات (السلع والخدمات) لتقديم عروض بيع دقيقة. إعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، مع تحديث بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم بانتظام. التواصل مع العملاء أو زيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحية المخولة، وإتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، وتوريدها للدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها لتقييم الأداء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع البيانات وتحليلها بشكل فعال. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. متطلبات العمل العمل بدوام كامل. القدرة على العمل في مدينة الطائف بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. الالتزام بتحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتحصيل الديون. بيئة العمل سيعمل مندوب المبيعات ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي في شركة هيفاء بديع القلم وشركاها العالميه للتجارة، حيث تتاح الفرصة لتطوير المهارات في بيئة داعمة تركز على تحقيق الأهداف وتنمية الأعمال. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

2fdcc0613a9fbd6b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كرم الوطن عن فني زراعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الفني والعلمي والمشورة في مجال الزراعة، بالإضافة إلى إجراء الاختبارات والتجارب اللازمة لدعم الإنتاج الزراعي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الاختبارات على عينات مثل الخلايا النباتية أو الأنسجة الحيوانية، وتحديد تأثيرات طرق الإنتاج المختلفة على النمو والعائد. اختبار جودة المنتجات الزراعية وتحديد الطفيليات أو الكائنات الضارة الأخرى. تفتيش المزارع وتقييم الظروف البيئية للنباتات والحيوانات، بما في ذلك الرطوبة والحرارة والنظافة. تقديم الدعم الفني والمشورة بخصوص تنفيذ إجراءات أو أساليب جديدة لزيادة الإنتاجية والعائد، والمساعدة في تطبيقها. تشغيل وصيانة المعدات البحثية المستخدمة لتحليل العينات وتحديد الكائنات الحية واختبار الجودة. دعم الأخصائيين الزراعيين والمزارعين في مهامهم. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الزراعة أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد للمبادئ الزراعية وتقنيات الإنتاج. القدرة على إجراء الاختبارات المعملية والميدانية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية ودقة في الملاحظة. القدرة على تقديم المشورة الفنية بوضوح. مهارات تشغيل وصيانة المعدات المتخصصة. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة كرم الوطن. يتطلب العمل التواجد الميداني في المزارع والمختبرات لإجراء المهام المطلوبة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

2f187591117cf4fe.description: About Novotel Hotels Novotel Hotels is part of the Accor network, a global group encompassing over 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants, and various lifestyle destinations. Accor is committed to fostering development and advancement opportunities for its team members. The organization emphasizes responsible hospitality, where every interaction contributes to a positive impact for customers, colleagues, and the planet. Role Overview: Director of Sales & Marketing Novotel Hotels in Makkah is seeking a Director of Sales & Marketing. This full-time role involves leading the sales and marketing efforts to achieve revenue growth and market positioning objectives for the hotel. The Director will be responsible for developing and executing strategies to maximize occupancy, Average Daily Rate (ADR), and RevPAR. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement comprehensive sales and marketing strategies to maximize hotel revenue, occupancy, ADR, and RevPAR. Lead, manage, and motivate the Sales & Marketing team, ensuring the achievement of departmental objectives and key performance indicators. Identify and develop new business opportunities across key market segments, including Hajj and Umrah operators, corporate accounts, travel agencies, tour operators, and international markets. Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, strategic partners, travel agencies, and corporate accounts to generate consistent business opportunities. Oversee the development and execution of integrated marketing campaigns, digital marketing initiatives, and promotional activities to strengthen the hotel's brand presence and market positioning. Develop and manage the annual sales and marketing budget, ensuring effective resource allocation and achievement of financial targets. Work closely with the Revenue Management team to develop pricing strategies, sales forecasts, market positioning, and distribution plans. Monitor market trends, competitor performance, customer preferences, and industry developments to identify opportunities and maintain a competitive advantage. Oversee key sales activities, including corporate negotiations, group bookings, international business development, client visits, and participation in industry events and trade shows. Manage the hotel's online presence and distribution channels, including the hotel's website, online travel agencies (OTAs), and other digital platforms, in coordination with relevant departments. Analyze sales performance, market share, campaign results, and revenue reports to evaluate effectiveness and implement corrective actions when required. Ensure all sales and marketing activities comply with hotel brand standards, company policies, and established operational procedures. Collaborate with the General Manager and other department heads to align commercial strategies with the hotel's overall business objectives and operational requirements. Prepare and present regular sales performance reports, market updates, business forecasts, and strategic recommendations to senior management. Drive continuous improvement, team development, and a customer-focused approach to support the hotel's long-term commercial success. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in sales and marketing, preferably within the hospitality sector. Demonstrated ability to develop and execute effective sales and marketing strategies. Proven leadership skills with experience managing and motivating a team. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role requires collaboration with various hotel departments and engagement with external partners and clients.

2f14f1ef223d49fa.description: About Mace Group Mace Group combines construction expertise with consultancy services, aiming to enhance project potential and redefine ambition. The company is currently providing strategic project management consultancy for significant new stadium builds, multiple stadium redevelopments, and wider precinct transformations in Riyadh. This scope includes delivering new stadiums, increasing existing stadium capacities, developing major mixed-use amenities, and implementing robust knowledge-transfer programs to ensure operational excellence and long-term sustainability beyond construction. The Role: FIFA Design Compliance Expert The FIFA Design Compliance Expert will join a dedicated team responsible for managing all FIFA and World Cup requirements throughout the design process for Stadium and Training site Programmes in Riyadh. This part-time role involves providing authoritative interpretation, design assurance, and strategic guidance from concept design through detailed design, technical approvals, and design freeze. The expert will collaborate closely with the client, World Cup Authority, FIFA, Lead Designers, specialist consultants, and programme teams to ensure that permanent works and planned overlay are coordinated, compliant, buildable, and aligned with operational, legacy, cost, and programmed objectives. Key Responsibilities Interface with FIFA, the World Cup Authority, and the client, contributing to design reviews, technical workshops, submissions, and approval meetings, and providing clear positions on compliance, design acceptability, derogations, and risks. Manage and maintain FIFA design requirements, compliance matrices, and design assurance plans, translating FIFA stadium standards and host requirements into clear briefs, criteria, and actions for all design disciplines. Review and challenge stadium designs from concept through detailed design to confirm compliance across various areas including field of play, seating bowl and sightlines, spectator circulation, accessibility, safety and security, broadcast, media, hospitality, team and official facilities, back-of-house areas, masterplan tournament mode design, logistics, transport interfaces, and fan experience. Establish design-stage compliance gateways and coordinate the preparation, quality assurance, and submission of design reports, drawings, schedules, dashboards, and evidence packs required for FIFA and authority reviews. Coordinate multidisciplinary design integration across architecture, structural engineering, MEP, ICT, security, fire and life safety, vertical transportation, landscape, wayfinding, acoustics, lighting, broadcast, and specialist venue systems, ensuring interfaces and spatial requirements are resolved before design freeze from a FIFA perspective. Coordinate permanent works with temporary and overlay requirements, identifying where provisions, capacities, routes, loadings, spaces, and connection points must be embedded in the base design to avoid late redesign or unnecessary long-term cost. Provide programme-wide design assurance across multiple stadiums and training facilities, reporting compliance status, design risks, departures, decisions, and mitigation actions, while promoting consistency and lessons learned across the venue portfolio. Advise client leadership and design teams on FIFA strategy, value engineering, design changes, approvals, and legacy outcomes, ensuring cost or programme decisions do not compromise mandatory compliance or venue functionality. Qualifications and Experience A degree in architecture, engineering, sports venue design, or a related discipline. Professional accreditation and FIFA-related credentials are desirable. Extensive design-stage experience on FIFA World Cup stadiums and training facilities, major football venues, or comparable international event venues, with involvement from concept design through detailed design and approvals. Proven experience interpreting FIFA stadium requirements and converting them into design briefs, compliance matrices, review comments, technical submissions, and coordinated design solutions. Strong technical understanding of stadium planning and design, including seating bowl geometry and sightlines, crowd movement, accessibility, safety and security, fire and life safety, broadcast and media, hospitality, player and official facilities, back-of-house operations, and overlay interfaces. Experience leading multidisciplinary design reviews and resolving interfaces between architecture, engineering, specialist venue systems, operational requirements, BIM coordination, and temporary event infrastructure. Programme-level experience providing design assurance across multiple stadiums, training sites, or sport venues, with the ability to manage compliance, risk, cost, programme, approvals, and legacy considerations. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the credibility to lead technical discussions, provide clear design direction, and constructively challenge consultants and senior stakeholders.

2f2b10e2b4f5c5b6.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع البحر الأحمر الطبي عن فني تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقه في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم الرعاية التمريضية الأساسية والشخصية للمرضى، والعمل تحت إشراف ممرض مسجل أو أخصائي رعاية صحية آخر. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم الفني للممرضين وأخصائيي الرعاية الصحية الآخرين في تخطيط وإدارة رعاية المرضى. المساعدة في إعطاء الأدوية الموصوفة وإحالة المرضى إلى أخصائيي الرعاية الصحية عند الحاجة. مساعدة المرضى في النظافة الشخصية والأنشطة الأساسية مثل الاغتسال والحلاقة. المساعدة في الأنشطة اليومية مثل تناول الطعام والتمرينات، وتقديم الوجبات والمشروبات حسب خطط الرعاية. مساعدة المرضى في التنقل والالتفاف وتغيير الوضع، بالإضافة إلى مساعدتهم في دخول دورات المياه وأثناء الاستحمام. تطوير المعرفة والخبرة الحفاظ على الخبرة الفنية وتحديث المعارف بشكل مستمر. دراسة المنشورات المتخصصة والمشاركة في الدورات التدريبية والمؤتمرات ذات الصلة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التمريض أو الرعاية الصحية ذات الصلة. القدرة على العمل تحت إشراف وتوجيه ممرض مسجل أو أخصائي رعاية صحية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن مجمع البحر الأحمر الطبي في ينبع، المدينة المنورة. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بتقديم رعاية عالية الجودة للمرضى ضمن بيئة عمل داعمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه.

2fb550902edb1a0b.description: About ARO Drilling ARO Drilling is seeking a Talent Acquisition Specialist II to join its team. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar. Utilize various recruitment channels to attract qualified candidates. Conduct candidate screenings and interviews. Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle. 2f311f66f7093aac.description: • قيادة وتوجيه فريق قسم البيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي لتحقيق أهداف الشركة. • تطوير استراتيجيات البيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي بما يتماشى مع رؤية وأهداف الشركة. • تصميم وتنفيذ حلول تحليلات البيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي لتحسين العمليات واتخاذ القرار. • الإشراف على جمع، تخزين، تنظيف، وتحليل البيانات لضمان جودة ودقة المعلومات. • التنسيق مع الأقسام الأخرى لضمان دمج حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي في العمليات التشغيلية بكفاءة. • متابعة أحدث التقنيات والتوجهات في مجال الذكاء الاصطناعي وتحليل البيانات وتقييم إمكانية تطبيقها في الشركة. • إدارة موازنات القسم وتخصيص الموارد بشكل فعال. • ضمان الامتثال للمعايير والأخلاقيات المتعلقة باستخدام البيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي. • تقديم تقارير دورية للإدارة العليا عن أداء القسم والمشاريع الحالية والمستقبلية. • تطوير مهارات فريق العمل من خلال التدريب والتوجيه المستمر. • خبرة لا تقل عن 6 سنوات في مجال البيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي. • فهم عميق لتقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي، تعلم الآلة، تحليل البيانات، والتعلم العميق. • مهارات قيادية عالية وقدرة على إدارة فرق متعددة التخصصات. • خبرة في تصميم وتنفيذ استراتيجيات البيانات والتحليلات. • معرفة جيدة ببرامج وأدوات البيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي الحديثة. • مهارات تواصل قوية وقدرة على العمل مع الأقسام المختلفة. • إلمام بمعايير حماية البيانات وأخلاقيات استخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي. • درجة البكالوريوس في علوم الحاسب، الهندسة، أو مجال ذي صلة؛ ويفضل الحاصلين على درجات متقدمة.

2fd8bd1e2ef705f2.company_name: مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات
2fd8bd1e2ef705f2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات عن مدرب رياضي للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الجوف، وتحديداً في قرية العليا والقريات. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال التدريب الرياضي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية اكتشاف ميول اللاعبين ومواهبهم واستعداداتهم، وإعداد خطط لتنميتها وتعزيزها وتنفيذها. إعداد الخطط التدريبية قصيرة وطويلة الأمد، وتطويرها لتحديد عناصر اللياقة البدنية وتنميتها. تطوير المهارات الأساسية للعبة الرياضية التي يتم تدريب اللاعبين عليها، وتقييم أدائهم وتنمية مهاراتهم. إدارة المقابلات الرياضية، وتوجيه اللاعبين وتبديلهم وفقاً لمجريات المقابلة. تطبيق قانون وقواعد اللعبة ومتابعة تطورها بشكل مستمر. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في مجال التدريب الرياضي. القدرة على اكتشاف وتطوير المواهب الرياضية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد الخطط التدريبية وتقييم الأداء. معرفة عميقة بقوانين وقواعد اللعبة الرياضية وتطوراتها. بيئة العمل يعمل المدرب الرياضي ضمن مشروع نظافة وصيانة وتشغيل المدينة السكنية بالحديثة، مما يتطلب الالتزام ببيئة عمل منظمة ومحددة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدن قرية العليا والقريات بمنطقة الجوف. تقديم التقارير يتولى المدرب مسؤولية إعداد وتقديم تقارير عمل دورية توثق تقدم اللاعبين والخطط التدريبية المنفذة، مع ضمان حفظ هذه التقارير بشكل دقيق ومنظم. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

2f71f0e0327524bf.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Cook I to join our team in Medina, Al Madinah. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience and involves preparing and cooking a variety of food items while adhering to quality and presentation standards. Key Responsibilities Prepare special meals or substitute items as required. Regulate the temperature of ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters to ensure proper cooking. Manage food thawing processes by pulling items from freezer storage to thaw in the refrigerator. Ensure proper portioning, arrangement, and garnishing of all food items. Maintain accurate food logs and monitor the quality and quantity of prepared food. Communicate assistance needed during busy periods and inform the Chef of excess food items for daily specials. Inform Food & Beverage service staff about menu specials and out-of-stock items. Prepare and cook food according to established recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklists. Prepare cold food items as needed. Operational Support and Team Collaboration Assist management with various tasks including hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. Serve as a role model for other team members. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues and support the team in achieving common goals. Listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Safety and Compliance Adhere to all company, safety, and security policies and procedures. Report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to the manager. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards in all tasks. Physical Requirements and Guest Service Anticipate and address guests’ service needs with professionalism. Communicate with others using clear and professional language. Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods. Capable of reaching overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Additional Duties Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors to support the kitchen operations and overall guest experience.

2f61c0d35ee46496.description: About the Role The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) is seeking a Legal Senior Researcher to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves operating with minimal supervision, working within established guidelines and procedures to prepare complex and specialized legal reports. The successful candidate will contribute to achieving milestones and operational targets within the assigned functional area. Role Purpose This position focuses on undertaking operational legal activities, including conducting comprehensive legal research and preparing legal studies for committees. These studies will primarily relate to fines and customs assessments imposed by ZATCA. A key responsibility will be ensuring the completeness and accuracy of data within legal files. Key Responsibilities Draft ZATCA legal lawsuit management policies, guidelines, and standard model forms. Assist in identifying opportunities for continuous improvement of legal systems, processes, and practices through research of global best practices and trends. Develop relevant templates for lawsuit management services across all ZATCA functions. Support the development of negotiating strategies in conjunction with internal stakeholders for effective legal case management. Manage the continuous update of lawsuit management database systems, ensuring request logs are current. Conduct preliminary evaluations to assist in determining the severity and urgency of litigation cases against ZATCA. Assist in representing ZATCA before judicial bodies, committees, and governmental authorities in cases for or against the authority, ensuring all necessary supporting documents are available. Prepare settlements for negotiation with employees and external entities involved in lawsuits against ZATCA (excluding audit and collection-related settlements). Archive judgments from lawsuits won by ZATCA for future reference. Identify outsourced legal experts to provide additional legal advice for managing internal and external non-tax, zakat, and customs litigation cases. Adhere to all relevant policies, processes, and standard operating procedures to ensure consistent work execution. Support junior team members in resolving escalated problems and provide necessary assistance for efficient work completion. Escalate complex problems to the appropriate personnel to ensure proper resolution of cases and issues. 2f7e52563cd77c4b.description: Job description Overview & Responsibilities The Senior Application Engineer serves as a technical authority and strategic commercial partner within the rotating equipment and turbomachinery manufacturing sector. This role is responsible for leading the design, proposal development, and commercial execution of mission-critical centrifugal machinery including compressors, steam turbines, expanders, and pumps—for major global clients across Petrochemical, LNG, and emerging Clean Energy markets. Position Purpose Serve as a technical subject matter expert in the application and system integration of centrifugal rotating equipment, including centrifugal compressors, steam turbines, expanders, and pumps. Architect and deliver competitive, high-reliability technical proposals and engineered-to-order solutions tailored to client specifications across the Petrochemical, LNG, and Sustainability markets. Deliver joint technical and commercial leadership to expand market share, support sales pursuits, and advance key strategic business initiatives. Serve as the primary technical bridge across multidisciplinary teams—liaising with engineering, operations, global manufacturing hubs, and customer representatives to clarify bid details and create high-impact promotional technical materials. Key Responsibilities Proposal Engineering & Equipment Design Inquiry Evaluation & Bid Strategy: Thoroughly analyze customer inquiries, design requests, and tender specifications to evaluate project objectives, aligning closely with sales teams to devise competitive bidding strategies based on market trends, budgets, and competitive dynamics. Aerodynamic & Mechanical Machine Sizing: Perform comprehensive machine sizing and engineering analyses, covering aerodynamic performance, rotordynamic stability, stress and strain evaluations, and overall mechanical integrity. Scope Definition & Balance of Plant: Define the scope of supply for equipment packages and auxiliary systems surrounding the primary turbomachinery train. Cost Engineering & Estimation: Build accurate cost models encompassing core hardware, labor, engineering hours, drafting, vendor-supplied components, testing, and project-specific contingency costs. Vendor Sourcing & Sub-Supplier Specifications: Author technical specifications for major purchased auxiliary equipment and act as the principal engineering authority managing sub-vendor technical evaluations. Proposal Delivery: Assemble and issue comprehensive proposal packages, including detailed engineering data sheets, performance curves, scope matrices, pricing breakdowns, project delivery schedules, and technical/commercial exceptions and deviations. Sales Support: Assist sales representatives in delivering technical presentations, value propositions, and bid walk-throughs to customer evaluation teams. Technical & Commercial Support (Quote-to-Award Phase) Bid Clarifications: Rapidly resolve technical and commercial queries raised by sales teams and client engineering teams throughout the bidding cycle. Proposal Optimization: Revise and re-rate equipment configurations, scopes, and proposals as project parameters and customer requirements evolve. Commercial Alignment: Partner with sales and executive management to fine-tune scope, delivery schedules, and pricing structures to maintain competitive positioning while preserving gross margins. Pre-Contract Alignment: Participate directly in pre-award meetings, customer clarification sessions, and contract negotiation discussions. Project Transfer & Post-Order Support Global Team Handover: Transition awarded contracts smoothly to project execution teams in the USA and Japan. Design Specification Handover: Prepare final design specifications and baseline engineering documents reflecting final negotiated terms. Kick-Off Coordination: Lead and attend internal and client-facing kick-off meetings and formal handover sessions. Project Definition Packages: Compile and deliver comprehensive project handover packages—including original and revised inquiry specifications, final scope definitions, detailed costing files, delivery milestones, and engineering schedules—to assigned Project Managers. Ongoing Engineering Advisory: Serve as the continuous technical and commercial consultant to the Project Manager throughout the detailed engineering, procurement, and testing phases. Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement Design Automation: Develop and refine standardized workflows, automating repetitive calculation routines and equipment selection procedures to accelerate inquiry turnaround times. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Enhance interface protocols and information sharing between internal divisions, specifically between the New Equipment engineering team and the Rerate/Aftermarket services group. Technology & Market Intelligence: Stay at the forefront of turbomachinery technology through industry periodicals, trade symposiums, technical papers, and formal internal/external training programs. Competitive Analysis: Monitor competitor offerings, patent releases, and customer trends to identify emerging technology applications and continuous product enhancement opportunities. Strategic Market Initiatives & Business Development Market Analytics: Leverage specialized engineering expertise, commercial insight, and industry networks to conduct quantitative and qualitative market assessments. Technical Thought Leadership: Author white papers, application guidelines, and technical reports to assist sales and marketing in launching new technologies and penetrating emerging applications. Client Engagement: Lead high-level technical presentations to engineering contractors (EPCs) and end users to drive brand preference and early-stage project specification development. Required Qualifications & Technical Competencies Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (or equivalent) with extensive understanding of aerodynamic and thermodynamic performance principles (gas properties, heat transfer, efficiency, head, work). Proven design and application knowledge of centrifugal compressors, steam turbines, expanders, pumps, and key auxiliary packages (motors, gears, lube systems, etc.). Strong mechanical and analytical capabilities in rotordynamics, bearings, seals, metallurgy/materials, and dynamic/thermal stress and strain. Proven techno-commercial capability to strategically balance equipment cost, performance, delivery lead times, and operating reliability. Familiarity with target sectors and emerging sustainability markets, including Hydrogen, CCS/CCUS, Ammonia, and Energy Storage. Strong written and verbal communication skills with high attention to detail for authoring customer proposals, technical papers, procedures, and presenting in commercial meetings. Proficiency with engineering application software, standard productivity tools (Word, Excel, Lotus Notes), and Sun/IBM operating environments. Ability to travel an average of 4–6 times per year (typically 2–3 days per trip) to support sales pursuits, attend pre-contract meetings, participate in trade shows/discussion groups, present technical papers, and complete off-site training. Base Location & Work Schedule ​This is a permanent full time, remote position based in Saudi Arabia or Bahrain. The world turns to Elliott. Customers throughout the world choose Elliott for the design, manufacture and service of their critical rotating equipment. Elliott’s global service network routinely installs, overhauls, repairs, upgrades and rerates machines from any manufacturer. Customers everywhere turn to Elliott for precision engineering, extraordinary reliability and unparalleled service. #LI-BD1 To learn more about our Job Applicant Privacy Notice, please click here . 2ffb4578d02373b2.description: Job description Company Description John Crane, a business of Smiths Group, is a global leader in mission-critical flow control solutions for energy and process industries that enable efficient and sustainable operations. Our products include mechanical seals and systems, couplings, filtration systems, and predictive digital monitoring technologies. We have a global network of more than 200 sites in over 50 countries and employ more than 6,000 people worldwide. We partner with our customers to help them keep their operations safe, reduce downtime, improve efficiency, and meet the latest environmental standards. John Crane is part of Smiths Group. For over 170 years, Smiths has been pioneering progress by engineering for a better future. We serve millions of people every year, helping to create a safer, more efficient, productive, and better-connected world across four global markets: energy, security & defence, space & aerospace, and general industrial. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, Smiths employs approximately 16,000 colleagues in over 50 countries. Job Description SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: The Reliability Engineer will provide on-site support to external customers by conducting failure analyses and reliability assessments of rotating equipment, with a particular focus on sealing systems. The role involves identifying performance and reliability improvement opportunities, troubleshooting equipment issues, and conducting root cause analyses (RCA) using established methodologies such as Fault Tree Analysis, Ishikawa (Fishbone) Diagrams, Apollo RCA, and other structured problem-solving techniques. The position also includes providing on-site technical support for John Crane products, supporting customer maintenance activities, and assisting with the installation, dismantling, inspection, and assembly of mechanical seals and related equipment. SPECIFIC DUTIES, ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO : Perform reliability analyses of customer rotating equipment, with a focus on sealing system performance and optimization. Lead and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) investigations involving sealing systems and rotating equipment, including site assessments, data collection, analysis, reporting, and presentation of findings and recommendations to customers. Conduct field troubleshooting activities, including problem diagnosis, development of corrective actions, and implementation of appropriate solutions in collaboration with customer teams. Deliver detailed technical presentations and recommendations to customers to support reliability improvement initiatives, sales opportunities, and RCA activities. Support customer sites with equipment measurements, seal installation, commissioning, and technical inspections. Ensure all work is performed in accordance with John Crane standards, procedures, quality requirements, and safety policies. Develop and maintain strong customer relationships through effective technical support and professional communication. Qualifications EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. Minimum of 5 years of experience in rotating equipment and sealing systems, with a strong focus on maintenance, reliability, and asset performance improvement. Solid understanding of industrial plant operations and maintenance environments, including work management systems, turnaround planning, maintenance planning, and scheduling processes. Experience working in a proactive, multinational, and multicultural environment. Strong technical knowledge of rotating equipment reliability principles and maintenance best practices. Knowledge of the John Crane product portfolio is considered an advantage. Professional certifications such as Vibration Analysis, Machinery Lubrication, Thermography, Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE), or Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) are highly desirable. Fluency in English is required; Arabic language skills are an advantage. Additional Information With colleagues stretching across the globe, we are proud of our diversity. To foster inclusivity, we run employee resource groups (ERGs) to provide a safe space for employees to connect and support each other. Our cross-business ERGs include Veterans, Pride Network, Black Employee Network, Women@Work Network, and Neurodiversity. Across our company, we recognize excellence, culminating in the Smiths Excellence Awards, our annual celebration of the most extraordinary activities, people, and projects that best showcase our strengths and help drive our business forward. We announce these on our annual Smiths Day, a global celebration of Smiths around our network. Join us for a great career with competitive compensation and benefits, while helping engineer a better future. We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds are what make a company flourish. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, economic status, disability, age, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are proud to be an inclusive company with values grounded in equality and ethics, where we celebrate, support, and embrace diversity. At no time during the hiring process will Smiths Group, nor any of our recruitment partners ever request payment to enable participation – including, but not limited to, interviews or testing.
