2ff224f40dfc7043.description: Job description About the role We are hiring an Assistant Vice President (AVP) to lead end‑to‑end post‑trade custody operations in Saudi Arabia , spanning clearing & settlement, cash & FX operational support, corporate actions/income, reconciliations, and client onboarding / account set‑up – Sunday to Thursday . You will drive service excellence , strong risk & control discipline , and regulatory adherence across the KSA post‑trade ecosystem: trading on Saudi Exchange , clearing via Muqassa (CCP) , and depository/settlement via Edaa , with settlement cash movements supported through SAMA . Why this role is important to us State Street is one of the world’s largest global custodians, with over USD 51.7 trillion in AUC/A , and is executing a growth strategy that includes expanding direct market presence. As part of this strategy, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) is a priority market , supported by Vision 2030 reforms , increasing foreign participation, and strong institutional demand. This role is critical to: Enabling scalable market entry and growth by delivering strong, controlled post‑trade operations aligned to local market infrastructure and rules. Ensuring a high-quality client experience through timely settlement, strong exception management, and robust controls as KSA market activity expands. Supporting the firm’s ability to deepen relationships with key institutional clients as the market evolves. Key responsibilities (KSA market aligned) 1) Clearing & Settlement (Equities, ETFs, Sukuk/Bonds) Own daily settlement processing for Saudi Exchange trades, settling at Edaa in line with market cycle (standard T+2 ; negotiated deals T+0 to T+5 , where applicable). Reconcile and validate client instructions, broker confirmations and Muqassa clearing outcomes; proactively resolve exceptions and breaks. Monitor fails, manage aged items, and coordinate remediation per Muqassa fails management processes and local cut‑offs. Manage instruction lifecycle (amend/cancel/partial handling where permitted) and maintain robust STP and control checks. 2) Cash & Funding (DvP / SAMA-linked settlement) Ensure funding readiness for DvP settlement and oversee cash settlement processing and reconciliations. (KSA market practice: securities settle gross; cash settles net via SAMA-linked settlement accounts ). Investigate and clear cash breaks within cut‑offs; escalate time‑critical issues with clear impact articulation. 3) FX Operations (Operational Support) Support FX activities required for settlement and client cash needs (confirmations, value dates, SSIs); drive timeliness and exception reduction. 4) Corporate Actions, Dividends & Income Manage end‑to‑end asset servicing: event capture, entitlement validation, booking/posting, reconciliations, and issue resolution with internal partners and vendors. 5) Client Onboarding / Account Set‑Up (Edaa structures) Lead operational onboarding to ensure accounts are set up correctly to be settlement‑ready (including Edaa account structures and investor identifiers required for local processing). Partner with Client Service, Compliance/KYC and market counterparts to deliver smooth go‑lives and operational readiness. 6) Controls, Governance & Audit Readiness Own daily controls, reconciliations, evidence retention and audit‑ready documentation; support internal/external audits and risk assessments. Maintain strong messaging discipline and operational risk management; experience with SWIFT MT and exposure to ISO 20022 MX preferred. 7) Leadership & Stakeholder Management Lead and develop a small‑to‑mid sized operations team; set objectives, coach performance and build cross‑coverage/skills resilience. Act as an escalation point and trusted partner for brokers, custodians, market infrastructures, correspondent banking partners and internal stakeholders (Ops, Risk, Technology, Client). Drive continuous improvement, automation, and standardization aligned to regional and global operating model. 2f93e40fb3c3454d.job_title: High Voltage Technician - Electrical Maintenance (Saudi Arabia)
2f93e40fb3c3454d.description: Eram Talent is seeking a skilled High Voltage Technician specializing in Electrical Maintenance to join a leading company in Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of high voltage electrical equipment to ensure optimal performance and safety. Responsibilities Perform routine and preventive maintenance on high-voltage electrical systems and equipment within water treatment and distribution facilities. Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair high-voltage transformers, switchgear, circuit breakers, and associated electrical components used in water utilities. Inspect electrical systems in pumping stations, desalination plants, and water networks to identify faults and implement effective corrective actions. Ensure strict compliance with safety standards, electrical codes, and company policies, particularly in water utility environments. Maintain accurate maintenance logs, service records, and prepare detailed technical reports. Collaborate with engineering, operations, and maintenance teams on system upgrades, expansions, and water infrastructure projects. Support installation, commissioning, and testing of electrical equipment in water and wastewater facilities. Adhere to high safety standards while working on both energized and de-energized systems, especially in wet and hazardous environments. Technical diploma in Electrical Engineering or related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in high-voltage electrical maintenance, preferably in water utilities (treatment plants, pumping stations, or desalination). Strong knowledge of transformers, switchgear, and circuit breakers. Skilled in troubleshooting and maintenance of high-voltage equipment. Familiar with electrical codes and safety regulations in Saudi Arabia. Basic knowledge of SCADA and motor control systems is an advantage. Good problem-solving skills and ability to work independently or in a team. Willing to work in Saudi Arabia and follow company policies.
